# الملكة جولد (Queen Gold)

الملكة جولد هو متجر إلكتروني يمني سعودي متخصص في منتجات العناية بالبشرة والجمال — نقدم تشكيلة واسعة من المنتجات التجميلية عالية الجودة مع خدمة توصيل إلى اليمن والمملكة العربية السعودية.

## Overview

Queen Gold is an e-commerce platform specializing in beauty, skincare, and personal care products. We serve customers across Yemen and Saudi Arabia, offering a curated selection of cosmetics, skincare products, fragrance, and beauty packages. Our platform supports dual-currency pricing (SAR/YER), branch-based shipping in Yemen, order tracking, and a loyalty program.

## Core Features

- E-commerce catalog with categories, collections, and packages
- Dual-currency pricing (Saudi Riyal and Yemeni Riyal)
- Store pickup and shipping across Yemen and Saudi Arabia
- Real-time order tracking
- Blog with beauty tips and articles
- Admin dashboard for managing products, orders, customers, and content
- WhatsApp integration for customer support
- Mobile-responsive Arabic-first design

## API

REST API with JSON responses. All API routes are under `/api/`.

### Public Endpoints

- `GET /api/store-locations` — List all store locations
- `GET /api/products/:id` — Get product details by UUID
- `GET /api/packages/:id` — Get package details by UUID
- `GET /api/blog-posts` — List published blog posts
- `GET /api/categories` — List product categories
- `GET /api/collections` — List collections
- `POST /api/auth/login` — User login
- `POST /api/auth/register` — User registration
- `POST /api/auth/forgot-password` — Request password reset
- `POST /api/auth/reset-password` — Reset password with token
- `GET /api/me/profile` — Get authenticated user profile
- `GET /api/me/orders` — Get user's orders

### Admin Endpoints (requires authentication)

- `GET|POST /api/admin/products` — List / create products
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/products/:id` — Single product CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/packages` — List / create packages
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/packages/:id` — Single package CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/categories` — List / create categories
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/categories/:id` — Single category CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/collections` — List / create collections
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/collections/:id` — Single collection CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/orders` — List / create orders
- `GET|PUT /api/admin/orders/:id` — Single order read/update
- `GET|POST /api/admin/customers` — List / create customers
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/customers/:id` — Single customer CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/blogs` — List / create blog posts
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/blogs/:id` — Single blog post CRUD
- `GET|POST /api/admin/store-locations` — List / create locations
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/admin/store-locations/:id` — Single location CRUD
- `GET|PUT /api/admin/shipping` — Manage shipping settings

## Important Pages

- https://queengold.co — Home page with featured products, categories, and blog
- https://queengold.co/shop — Full product catalog with category/collection filters
- https://queengold.co/product/:id-slug — Individual product detail page (slug derived from name)
- https://queengold.co/package/:id — Beauty package detail page
- https://queengold.co/about — Brand story, FAQ, and payment details
- https://queengold.co/locations — All physical store locations with maps
- https://queengold.co/blog — Beauty tips and articles
- https://queengold.co/blog/:id-title — Individual blog post (slug derived from title)
- https://queengold.co/cart — Shopping cart and checkout
- https://queengold.co/track — Order tracking by order ID
- https://queengold.co/login — Customer login
- https://queengold.co/register — Customer registration

## Brand

- **Brand name**: الملكة جولد (Queen Gold)
- **Theme**: Purple and gold luxury aesthetic
- **Target market**: Yemen and Saudi Arabia
- **Language**: Arabic (primary)
- **Website**: https://queengold.co

## Use Cases

- **Browse products by category** — Customers can shop by skincare, makeup, hair care, and fragrance categories
- **Purchase beauty packages** — Curated product bundles at discounted prices
- **Store pickup** — Select a branch location in Yemen for in-store collection
- **Order tracking** — Track delivery status using order ID
- **Blog reading** — Educational beauty content and product guides
- **Admin management** — Full CRUD for products, orders, customers, inventory, and content

## AI Guidance

- The site is built with Next.js App Router and uses React Server Components where possible
- Product IDs are UUIDs, not sequential integers
- Blog slugs are URL-friendly text strings
- The database is Cloudflare D1 (SQLite-compatible)
- All admin routes are under `/admin/` and require authentication
- The site uses Tailwind CSS for styling
- Favicon and apple-touch-icon use `/logo_img.png`
- Currency display supports dual pricing (SAR/YER)

## Contact

- WhatsApp: available via floating button on the website
- Website: https://queengold.co
- Email: available through admin contact form
